edits.new: The observed lane-4 excursion was minus 54 degrees Celsius for twenty-two minutes, against an allowed range of minus 80 to minus 60 degrees Celsius for frozen drug substance stored at a set point of minus 70 degrees Celsius [CHILL]. This unresolved lane-4 stability disposition is a blocking finding that prevents commercial restart [REVIEW].
edits.old: The observed lane-4 excursion was minus 54 degrees Celsius for twenty-two minutes, against an allowed range of minus 80 to minus 60 degrees Celsius for frozen drug substance stored at minus 70 degrees Celsius [CHILL]. This unresolved lane-4 stability disposition is a blocking finding that prevents commercial restart [REVIEW].

edits.new: The clean-water facility operates at 82 degrees Celsius, and every return must remain at least 80 degrees Celsius for three consecutive thirty-minute windows to be considered usable [CURRENT]. Usable power is 5.4 megawatts versus 7.1 megawatts installed capacity, and the generator provides 3.2 megawatts for twenty-eight hours [CURRENT]. Stale generator-transfer evidence must be replaced with current U11 data before restart authorization [CURRENT, REVIEW].
edits.old: Stale generator-transfer evidence must be replaced with current U11 data before restart authorization [CURRENT, REVIEW].

edits.new: Analytical potency is currently 91 percent of reference, within the approved specification of 85 to 115 percent [ASSAY]. Endotoxin is 0.18 EU/mL, which is below the limit of 0.25 EU/mL; a legacy 0.50 EU/mL method is superseded and cannot govern current release [ASSAY]. However, the unresolved lane-4 stability disposition remains a blocker for lot release and commercial restart [CHILL, ASSAY, REVIEW].
edits.old: Analytical potency is currently 91 percent of reference, within the approved specification of 85 to 115 percent [ASSAY]. However, the unresolved lane-4 stability disposition remains a blocker for lot release and commercial restart [CHILL, ASSAY, REVIEW].

edits.new: The recipe-signing key was not exposed and remains current under key-set K7 [GUARD]. The service account was disabled at 09:40 UTC to mitigate risk [GUARD]. Break-glass access expires after two hours and requires dual approval plus immutable session logging [GUARD]. Remote recipe deployment is blocked until GUARD validation of K7 and access logs confirms integrity [GUARD, REVIEW].

edits.new: Current diesel stock covers twenty-eight hours at emergency load and seventeen hours at full production load [SUPPLY]. Stoppers cover 4.2 days, while resin coverage is only 2.6 batches [SUPPLY]. Mutual aid provides five qualified operators beginning at 05:30 UTC with travel uncertainty of plus or minus seventy-five minutes [SUPPLY].
